title: NGINX archive digest can be unset before Framework provisioning
title_de: NGINX-Archiv-Digest kann vor Framework-Provisioning unset sein
summary: The Framework NGINX release-archive path accepted an empty digest and extracted the archive after recording a local-only hash. The reviewed release-1.31.2 tag, nginx-1.31.2.tar.gz asset, and published SHA-256 repair was squash-merged into Framework master 9954b99a31fab0006cdf903ab477c8158c50fea8. Exact post-merge lint, common-structure, and CodeQL passed; the independent master Sonar backlog failed, so the finding remains fixed pending current-master Quality-Gate verification.
summary_de: Der Framework-NGINX-Release-Archivpfad akzeptierte einen leeren Digest und extrahierte das Archiv nach Aufzeichnung eines nur lokalen Hashes. Die Reparatur mit überprüftem Tag release-1.31.2, Asset nginx-1.31.2.tar.gz und veröffentlichtem SHA-256 wurde per Squash in Framework-master 9954b99a31fab0006cdf903ab477c8158c50fea8 gemergt. Exakter Post-Merge-Lint, common-structure und CodeQL bestanden; der unabhängige Master-Sonar-Backlog schlug fehl, daher bleibt das Finding fixed bis zur Current-Master-Quality-Gate-Verifikation.
observed_behavior: Before the fix, an unset, whitespace-only, whitespace-appended, or malformed NGINX_SHA256 was not rejected before the archive selection/download path, and the old code accepted an empty value by recording a local hash instead of enforcing equality before tar extraction.
observed_behavior_de: Vor dem Fix wurde ein nicht gesetztes, nur aus Whitespace bestehendes, mit nachgestelltem Whitespace versehenes oder malformedes NGINX_SHA256 nicht vor dem Archive-Selection-/Download-Pfad zurückgewiesen, und der alte Code akzeptierte einen leeren Wert, indem er einen lokalen Hash aufzeichnete statt Gleichheit vor der tar-Extraction durchzusetzen.
expected_behavior: Every NGINX github-release archive candidate must have a non-empty syntactically valid digest before latest resolution, cache use, download, or extraction. A fixed release's source ref, expected asset name, and digest are one reviewed tuple; the exact private archive input passed to tar must be reverified against that digest.
expected_behavior_de: Jeder NGINX-github-release-Archive-Candidate muss vor Latest-Resolution, Cache-Nutzung, Download oder Extraction einen nicht leeren syntaktisch gültigen Digest besitzen. Source-Ref, erwarteter Asset-Name und Digest eines festen Releases bilden ein überprüftes Tupel; die exakte private Archive-Eingabe für tar muss erneut gegen diesen Digest verifiziert werden.
impact: Before the fix, substituted NGINX release-archive bytes could be extracted and built when the digest was absent. The task branch closes that source-archive integrity boundary; post-merge verification remains required before the finding can become verified.
impact_de: Vor dem Fix konnten ersetzte NGINX-Release-Archivbytes bei fehlendem Digest extrahiert und gebaut werden. Der Task-Branch schließt diese Source-Archive-Integrity-Grenze; vor dem Status verified bleibt eine Post-Merge-Verifikation erforderlich.

root_cause: The NGINX release-archive path conditionally compared NGINX_SHA256 only when it was nonempty; otherwise it recorded a local hash and extracted the candidate archive.
root_cause_de: Der NGINX-Release-Archivpfad verglich NGINX_SHA256 nur bedingt, wenn es nicht leer war; andernfalls zeichnete er einen lokalen Hash auf und extrahierte das Candidate-Archiv.
proposed_remediation: Require NGINX_SHA256 before NGINX preparation and again at the archive use point; bind a fixed tag to its expected official release asset and reviewed published SHA-256, validate fixed/latest-resolved tags, verify cached or refreshed candidates, stage a private copy under NGINX_BUILD_DIR, reverify it, and pass only that copy to tar.
proposed_remediation_de: NGINX_SHA256 vor der NGINX-Preparation und erneut am Archive-Use-Point verlangen; einen festen Tag an sein erwartetes offizielles Release-Asset und den überprüften veröffentlichten SHA-256 binden, feste/per-latest-aufgelöste Tags validieren, gecachte oder per Refresh erneuerte Candidates verifizieren, eine private Kopie unter NGINX_BUILD_DIR stagen, erneut verifizieren und nur diese Kopie an tar übergeben.

A matching digest succeeds and tar receives only the reverified private archive copy.
The fixed tag, matching source ref, expected release asset name, and published SHA-256 remain a reviewed tuple; a newer tag produces no automatic partial update.
Latest resolution, release/source overrides, cache/refresh, existing archives, and candidate-path replacement retain the same enforcement.
The Framework change remains separate from FND-FRAMEWORK-0005, Parent Gitlink work, and MRTS.

Run Framework documentation, static lint, live release-metadata updater readback, and diff validation in the task worktree.
Create a Framework-only Draft PR and verify its exact head, applicable checks, review state, and Sonar disposition before verified_pr.
After an explicitly authorized merge, rerun the original condition on current master before changing the finding from fixed to verified.
legitimate_control_tests: A matching deterministic local archive digest reaches tar through verified-archives.
The default release tag, ref, asset name, and SHA-256 resolve as the reviewed tuple.
A latest-release cache fallback with the matching digest succeeds.
A REFRESH=1 archive replacement downloads, verifies, and extracts only the private verified copy.
dependencies: Framework PR #25 is merged at master 9954b99a31fab0006cdf903ab477c8158c50fea8; the exact post-merge SonarCloud master Quality Gate is failed under independent FND-SONAR-0002, so verification/closure remains blocked without an unrelated Sonar remediation authorization.
Future NGINX upgrades require a reviewed atomic release-tag, asset-name, and published-SHA-256 change; the updater intentionally produces no partial update.

root_cause_triage.source: Downloaded NGINX GitHub release archive bytes while NGINX_SHA256 defaulted to an empty value in ci/lib/common.sh.
root_cause_triage.broken_control_or_sink: Pre-fix download_nginx_source accepted an empty NGINX_SHA256 after local hash recording and passed the selected candidate directly to tar extraction.
attacker_preconditions: The github-release NGINX source-build path ran with NGINX_SHA256 unset, whitespace-only, trailing-whitespace, malformed, or mismatching.
The selected release archive was substituted or differed from the intended release before Framework consumption.
No substituted real upstream archive was fetched or executed during this local-fixture remediation.
root_cause_triage.impact: Unverified NGINX archive contents could be extracted and built in the Framework NGINX provisioning path before the repair.
countercontrols: The source repository remains constrained to an HTTPS GitHub owner/repo URL and release references are validated.

The repaired path defaults to the reviewed release tag/asset/digest tuple, verifies candidate and staged extraction copies, and blocks explicit-empty, mismatching, or tuple-inconsistent input before tar.
root_cause_triage.root_control_boundary: Framework NGINX release-archive integrity enforcement before extraction.
root_cause_triage.parent_impact: None for this remediation. A Framework fix has no Parent source change and requires a separately authorized gitlink update if consumed by Parent.
root_cause_triage.mrts_impact: none; no MRTS path is involved.
required_regression_tests: Unset, whitespace-only, trailing-whitespace, malformed, and mismatched NGINX digests fail before tar extraction using isolated fixtures.
A matching reviewed NGINX digest allows the fixture archive to reach tar through the private verified path.
Candidate replacement, latest resolution, overrides, cache, and refresh retain fail-closed verification.
required_legitimate_control_cases: A correct digest for a fixed supported github-release fixture archive succeeds under the existing external build-root contract.
bypass_review: latest-release resolution, source-repository and release-tag overrides, cache/refresh behavior, whitespace digest values, pre-existing archives, and archive-path replacement.

Exact PR-head checks passed, but the resulting master SonarCloud Quality Gate failed under independent FND-SONAR-0002, so the finding remains fixed rather than verified.
proof_gaps: No real upstream archive substitution was attempted; deterministic local archive fixtures exercise the control boundary.
The fixed release tuple was directly verified; a future release requires fresh upstream metadata and asset-digest review.

residual_risk: The fixed default relies on GitHub's published release-asset digest and HTTPS metadata availability. Future upgrades require fresh reviewed atomic provenance. The code is merged, but FND-SONAR-0002's failed exact resulting-master Quality Gate prevents verified/closed. No risk has been accepted.
residual_risk_de: Der feste Standard stützt sich auf GitHubs veröffentlichten Release-Asset-Digest und die Verfügbarkeit der HTTPS-Metadaten. Künftige Upgrades erfordern frisch überprüfte atomare Provenance. Der Code ist gemergt, aber FND-SONAR-0002s fehlgeschlagenes exaktes resultierendes Master-Quality-Gate verhindert verified/closed. Es wurde kein Risiko akzeptiert.

history.detail: Created by the one-time finding-management bootstrap from retained evidence; no remediation, verification, closure, or risk acceptance was performed.

Current Framework static evidence at cdc91a398d6c156eaff927d742b23018a3817fb6 confirmed optional NGINX digest enforcement before extraction. It remains separate from the PCRE2 digest finding because the consumer, helpers, patch, and regression fixtures differ.

The Framework task branch requires an exactly 64-character syntactically valid NGINX digest before archive use, including rejection of trailing whitespace; it revalidates cached/refreshed candidates and the private extraction copy, and passed the seven-test local regression plus shell, documentation, lint, and diff checks. The finding is fixed pending Framework Draft-PR exact-head and post-merge master verification.

Framework Draft PR #25 matched local, remote, and PR-head SHA 7a61a34ed5531f1f399a88e26e6242c7cacae412; SonarCloud and scaffold-lint passed, and no review threads existed. The applicable test-common/common-structure check failed with expected 141 YAML cases, found 179, which also fails on master at cdc91a398d6c156eaff927d742b23018a3817fb6. The unrelated workflow/case-count repair is outside this task, so delivery is blocked rather than verified_pr.

PR #25 synchronized to c5e7553cf5f3eb7c5535e392798e03ae21f81981 after the common-structure and action-pin merges. The focused NGINX regression passed 7/7, shell syntax and aggregate lint passed, and all exact-head GitHub checks passed including common-structure, CodeQL, and SonarCloud. The former YAML-count blocker is resolved; delivery remains blocked because no repository-configured or authorized nonempty NGINX_SHA256 source exists for a real upstream github-release archive. A PR comment records the no-invented-digest/no-weakened-control disposition.

Official nginx/nginx release-1.31.2 metadata and a direct HTTPS asset download established the reviewed nginx-1.31.2.tar.gz / af2a957c41da636ddc4f883e4523c6d140b4784dbce42000c364ae5092aa473c tuple. The twelve focused archive/provenance tests, shell/Python syntax checks, full native Framework lint, live updater no-partial-update readback, Parent-clean check, and no-MRTS-diff check passed. New exact-head delivery and post-merge master verification remain pending.

PR #25 exact head c6ba5e11359d6eb30e8717b766d49697f9bed74f was squash-merged at master 9954b99a31fab0006cdf903ab477c8158c50fea8. Exact master lint, test-common/common-structure, and CodeQL passed, but SonarCloud failed under independent FND-SONAR-0002. This is an unmerged merge blocker only; Framework master 9954b99a31fab0006cdf903ab477c8158c50fea8 retains the fixed control.
